title: Close, bolt and latch a double-door enclosure whose astragal forces the leaf order
instruction: Close the blue-grey enclosure's two doors and secure them with the bolt and the latch.
context: On a no-centre-post electrical cabinet the active door's astragal overlaps the seam, so the passive door shuts first and is bolted into the header keeper; the active door is then held by a quarter-turn cam latch whose cam turns behind the frame. Electrical safety practice (NFPA 70E) counts equipment as in normal operation only with doors closed and secured. Done by: electricians (47-2111.00), commercial and industrial equipment repairers (49-2094.00), general maintenance and repair workers (49-9071.00).
setup: Positions in mm in one frame shared by all three mechanisms: origin on the table top 215 mm in front of the arm bases and midway between them (world 0.215, 0, 0.7475 m, yaw 0), in the plane of the closed doors; x away from the robot, y to the robot's left, z up. Doors open toward the robot. Friction 0.8 static, 0.6 dynamic everywhere. No other objects. Cylinders are vertical unless marked along x. ENCLOSURE (fixed to the table), powder-coated steel, blue-grey RGB (0.12,0.32,0.52), boxes as centre / size: floor (70,0,3) / 140x252x6; roof (76,0,167) / 128x252x6; back (137,0,85) / 6x252x170; sides (74,+-123,85) / 132x6x170; door-stop flanges (13,+-114,85) / 6x12x158; header bars (13,0,10) and (13,0,160) / 6x216x6. Keeper, bare steel RGB (0.48,0.52,0.57), a 16 mm square bore 12 mm tall centred (-10,40,174): walls (-20,40,174) and (0,40,174) / 4x24x12, (-10,30,174) and (-10,50,174) / 16x4x12; rear bridge to the header (7,40,174) / 10x24x12. Spring catch: brass ball, radius 3 mm, 3 g, at (-15.8,40,167), slides along x -4..0 mm, spring 300 N/m toward +x (rest +3.8 mm), damping 0.05 N s/m, starts at 0. LEFT (PASSIVE) DOOR: fixed painted-steel hinge pin cylinder radius 3, height 140 at (0,120,85). Leaf, 180 g with its hardware, hinged about z at (0,120,85), range -100..0 degrees (0 closed), starts 50 degrees open (-50), damping 0.020 N m s/rad, no spring: painted-steel sheet (0,61,85) / 3x118x152; brass pull bar cylinder radius 4, height 50 at (-14,24,92) on brass standoffs (-7,24,70) and (-7,24,114) / 14x8x6; two bare-steel bolt guide rings at z=125 and z=148, each four boxes (-17.5,40) and (-2.5,40) / 3x18x5 plus (-10,32.5) and (-10,47.5) / 12x3x5. Bolt, 20 g, bare steel with a brass post, slides up along z 0..15 mm, starts down (0), damping 0.020 N s/m; at 0: rod radius 4 from z=120 to 149.5, neck radius 3 from 149.5 to 154.5, rod radius 4 from 154.5 to 158, rounded tip sphere radius 4 at (-10,40,158), arm box (-34,40,122) / 48x6x6, brass post cylinder radius 8, height 25 at (-58,40,137.5). RIGHT (ACTIVE) DOOR: fixed painted-steel hinge pin radius 3, height 140 at (0,-120,85). Leaf, 200 g with its hardware, hinged about z at (0,-120,85), range 0..100 degrees (0 closed), starts 70 degrees open (+70), damping 0.020 N m s/rad, no spring: painted-steel sheet (0,-61,85) / 3x118x152; brass pull bar radius 4, height 50 at (-14,-24,92) on brass standoffs (-7,-24,70) and (-7,-24,114) / 14x8x6; bare-steel astragal strip (-9,5,85) / 3x18x152, covering the passive sheet's free edge 6 mm in front of it; bare-steel astragal spacer strip (-4.5,-5,85) / 6x4x152; latch bezel radius 11, length 3 along x at (-3,-45,137) and housing behind the sheet radius 8, length 13 along x at (8,-45,137), black powder-coated zinc alloy RGB (0.05,0.05,0.05). LATCH (quarter-turn cam latch with a wing knob, sized after the Southco E5 mini), 25 g, hinged about x at (0,-45,137) on the active leaf, range 0..90 degrees, 0 latched (wing vertical, cam up behind the upper header bar), starts 90 (unlatched, wing horizontal, cam toward the hinge), turned counter-clockwise as seen from the front to latch, joint stiction 0.05 N m static, 0.04 N m dynamic, damping 0.002 N m s/rad, armature 1e-5 kg m2; at 0: black zinc-alloy wing knob box (-10.75,-45,137) / 11.5x7x33 and spindle radius 3, length 22 along x at (5.5,-45,137); zinc-plated steel RGB (0.70,0.72,0.75) cam box (17.5,-45,143.6) / 2x12.2x25.4 with rounded tip radius 6.1, length 2 along x at (17.5,-45,156.3). Bolt and latch do not collide with their own leaf (their joints keep them on axis; the spindle passes through bezel, sheet and housing). The README lists the same colliders as a table.
scoring: Hinge angles; for a tape measure, a leaf's free-edge gap from its closed line is 118 mm x sin(angle), about 2 mm per degree. Latch angle 0 is latched (wing knob vertical); 90 is unlatched (wing horizontal). 1.0: both leaves within 1.0 degree of closed (free edge within 2 mm of its closed line), the bolt raised at least 10 mm of its 15 mm travel (its rounded tip at least 4 mm inside the 12 mm tall keeper bore) and the latch within 10 degrees of latched (wing knob within 10 degrees of vertical, its top end within 2.9 mm sideways of the latch axis; the cam then overlaps the header bar by at least 5.1 mm), with both grippers at least 30 mm from each leaf's, the bolt's and the latch's bounding box, hinge and latch speeds below 0.05 rad/s and bolt speed below 0.010 m/s, all continuously for 1 s. 0.75: the same closed, bolted and latched geometry while held, moving, or before the 1 s has passed. 0.5: both leaves within 1.0 degree of closed, but the bolt raised less than 10 mm or the latch more than 10 degrees from latched, or both. 0.25: passive leaf within 1.0 degree of closed and bolt raised at least 10 mm, active leaf more than 1.0 degree open. Otherwise 0, including the untouched start, a passive leaf more than 1.0 degree open, and a raised bolt on an open passive leaf. The score is the end state; there is no sticky penalty, because contact enforces the order: a shut astragal stops a passive leaf closed second 6.46 degrees open, a raised bolt hits the keeper 12.25 degrees open and a thrown cam hits the header bar 6.97 degrees open, so a leaf closed out of order, or with its fastener already thrown, cannot reach the closed band, and an attempt that is undone and redone in the right order scores in full. A latched active leaf pulled open stops 0.35 degrees open, inside the closed band, and the latch turns to 10 degrees only on an active leaf less than 0.37 degrees open. Online, speeds are joint-value changes between 20 Hz steps; offline static layouts use reported velocities and assume release. Success: score 1.0 held a further 1 s.
reset_notes: Set the passive (left) leaf 50 degrees open, the active (right) leaf 70 degrees open, the latch unlatched (90 degrees, wing horizontal), the bolt down at 0 and the catch at 0, all at rest; clear the scorer's hold timers. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid primitives model the astragal overlap, the bolt and keeper, a spring-ball catch in the bolt rod's neck, and a quarter-turn latch with one flat cam (no draw-in ramp, no multi-point rods); joint stiction stands in for the latch's holding spring, and with no gasket a thrown latch leaves 0.5 mm of play. Hinges and slides are passive and damped, with end stops. The passive leaf has one top bolt. Bending, seals, electrical and fire hazards, certification and full-size door inertia are omitted.
